blocks.content: NITI Aayog serves as the premier policy think tank of the Government of India, providing directional and policy inputs while fostering cooperative federalism.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Fosters Cooperative Federalism by facilitating structured, continuous support and mechanisms with States on a partner basis.
Adopts a Bottom-Up approach to formulate plans at the village level and aggregate them progressively at higher levels of government.
Functions as a premier policy 'Think Tank' providing strategic, long-term policy and directional framework for the Government of India.
Encourages Competitive Federalism by benchmarking state performance through indices like the SDG India Index and India Innovation Index.
Serves as a platform for dispute resolution between different ministries and between the Centre and States.

rows: Advisory body; No power to allocate funds
Empowered to allocate funds to ministries and states
Equal partners in the Governing Council
Limited role through the National Development Council (NDC)

items: NITI Aayog does NOT possess powers to allocate funds to states or ministries; financial allocations are handled by the Ministry of Finance.
The Governing Council of NITI Aayog comprises the Prime Minister, Chief Ministers of all States, and Lt. Governors of Union Territories.
Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) and the SDG India Index are key initiatives driven directly by NITI Aayog.
